input.name: Stillwater KPU-T256
input.notes:
High-performance KPU SKU for edge servers, autonomous vehicles, advanced
drones. 256 tiles in a 16x16 grid, 32x32 PE arrays (262,144 PEs total).
Tile microarchitecture is uniform with T64 / T128 so cost / perf curves
across the entry / mid / high tier are continuous. 30W default with 15W
and 50W profiles. TSMC N16, ~315 INT8 TOPS at the default profile (600 MHz @ 0.75V; the earlier ~734 figure was from a 1400 MHz operating point retired in PR #153 when Vdd-aware DVFS replaced fixed-Vdd clocks).
